about: Where app/agents/obs.js sends page views and reads, when it is switched on. Public on purpose: an append token can only write to its lane, and the key can only encrypt. The vault exists (zd1cb3kt, made 11 November 2026 at Dinis Cruz's word, with two append lanes). Still off until the key the events are sealed to is chosen (asked of Dinis in agents/observability/status.json). No place lookup, ever: this site asks no third party about its visitors.
